messages:
tess: Heads-up: hotfix PR #6221 (prod crash on model load) needs two approvals before 11:00 PT cutoff so we can ship in today's release window. Current status: tests ✅, e2e flaky but passing locally. @ben @kai can you take a look?
ben: On it, pulling the branch now: `git fetch && gh pr checkout 6221`
sasha: Security already gave a thumbs up on the dependency change, pinged via email. there's one minor nit in the logging line.
kai: I can do a quick review in ~15m. If it's small i'll approve.
release-bot: Reminder: release window cutoff in 45 minutes (11:00 PT). Please get required approvals or request exception.
maria: Does merging this block other PRs in the queue? I can reorder the merge queue if needed.
ben: Small nit: rename var `resp` -> `response` in `src/serve/loader.go`, otherwise looks good. leaving inline comment.
kai: Read through, tests look good to me. I can waive the nit for this hotfix. LGTM :thumbsup: 
tess: Thanks @kai — @ben can you drop an approval once inline nit is fixed? we need one more explicit approve to meet the "two approvals" requirement.
ben: Fix pushed: switched resp->response, kicked CI. approving after green.
release-bot: CI passed for PR #6221 — all checks green.
ben: LGTM — approving now. :white_check_mark:
tess: Merging in 2m after final checks, thanks everyone. @release-bot, please lift merge hold.
release-bot: Merge executed: PR #6221 merged into main by @tess at 1865123490.
